description:
Technology Compatibility Kit for the build-time metadata hand-off. Abstract JUnit 5 bases a
        producer of exeris-metadata/<entity>.json, a reader of it, and a consumer of the AST wire
        format extend to prove they satisfy the contract the SDK publishes — turning the ADR-042
        "the reader reads what the processor writes" parity discipline into an executable gate.
        Depend on it with test scope.
